thread:
Ravi Menon: Hey team, NewBridge sent back the RFI. Two quick asks: 1) explicit wording on HSM support/FIPS, 2) a cost-per-1k-vectors row in the capability matrix. I dropped the draft RFI into /drive/newbridge/rfi/nb_rfi_draft.docx. Can SE + Security sign off by EOD? @Lina @Priya

Lina Ortega: I'll update the matrix with a cost row. Quick question: what batching assumption should we use — x4 or x6? That changes the hosted estimate.

Noah Kim: From previous POCs we use x6 as the conservative default for throughput numbers. Use x6 for hosted, but note the formula in a footnote. I'll add a small example calc.

Priya Shah: HSM wording suggestion (copyable): "Redwood supports customer-managed encryption keys via cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS) for hosted services. For Private/on-prem deployments Redwood integrates with PKCS#11-compatible HSMs and supports deployment with FIPS 140-2 validated appliances; keywraps can be handled via KMIP or PKCS#11. Redwood does not escrow customer keys by default." Thoughts?

Lina Ortega: Looks good. I'll paste that into the sec questionnaire answer.

Ravi Menon: For cost per 1k vectors use this placeholder: hosted = $0.50 per 1k vectors (assumes x6 batching), dedicated baseline = $0.18 per 1k vectors (based on dedicated-4gpu monthly commit). I'll add the formula note.

Noah Kim: I'll attach a short curl example for their infra: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-lite","input":["hi"],"batch_hint":6}'
```

Ravi Menon: Action items: @Lina update CSV + insert cost calc by 11:30am. @Priya finalize HSM sentence and paste in sec questionnaire by 4pm. @Noah attach the curl example to the packet. I'll mark the CRM RFI answered after signoff.
